Relates to  #191500 
 Problem 
 FakeTensor's dispatch cache stores a recipe for rebuilding an output, not the output itself. On every cache hit, the old code rebuilt all strided outputs with  empty_strided ; views then rebound that placeholder to the current input with  set_ . Fo
news.aiSummary: This patch addresses an inefficiency in PyTorch's FakeTensor dispatch cache, which previously rebuilt strided outputs on every cache hit.
